newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks followed through on Tuesday's strength to open higher on Wednesday, but analysts said that trading was likely to be slow before Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up four points at 7,042.
Greenspan is scheduled to give his twice-yearly review of the U.S. economy to the Senate banking comittee at 1500 GMT.
The Nasdaq Composite was up three at 1,350 while the S&P Index was up fractionally at 812. The 30-year long bond was off 4/32 to yield 6.67 percent.
